captures.description: Six Punks, observed, seed 0, first person, 4 fps tiled 5x4, 0-5 s (walk-ins). sheet_1..4.png follow in 5 s steps; rec_obs/bot.avi and bot.log alongside. Punks step back and out after attacking, no zips, no two-Punk wall while the rear warning lights; one holder at the nose for 2-3 s in sheets 2 and 3.
Six Punks, passive, seed 0, first person, 4 fps tiled 5x4, 5-10 s (sheet_0..4.png in 5 s steps; bot.avi, bot.log, readability.json alongside: R8 p95 47%, R12 KO 16.1 s, worst 2 s 30).

Observed act re-recorded with the scratch bot, 12 fps tiled 5x4, 14.7-16.4 s: a Punk at +18 degrees ends its attack at the nose, holds about a third of a second, then walks off to its slot at walking pace while another steps in from the centre. back_f1290.png (21.4 s, a Punk at +22 degrees walks off to the left while a Punk at the right edge punches) and back_f491.png (8.1 s) are the other two windows.

feel_judgement: Judged from first-person sheets of the observed and passive acts (seed 0): after the fix a Punk ends its attack in front of the player, holds still for about a third of a second (the punish window), then walks off to its slot at walking pace; there are no sideways zips and no dashes past the shoulder (peak walking speed is now 3.0 m/s, wrong-way frames 0), and I saw no two-Punk wall at the lens while rear hits and the warning corner landed. With the 5 s cooldown the crowd reads as a few Punks posturing in guard stance on the ring (about a third of six, not the 'most' of SPEC 7) with one or two stepping in, instead of a Punk always at the nose. What still reads badly: a single token holder standing at strike range, covering 40-60% of the lens, for 2-3 s while the player is staggered by rear hits (the director withholds the go, the holder waits at the nose with no attack to read). Pressure is much lower than before: Waves hits in 90 s from the held-back autopilot go 32.8 to 9.5 and fight hits in 25 s 23.5 to 9.8, though a passive player still dies in 14-16 s and the worst 2 s of damage stays at the limit of 30. That is a density question for the lead, not a cooldown one.
judgement_calls: The reset is one helper (_reset_avoidance) called from every stop and from every entry into APPROACH and RECOVER, not only the three transitions the finding names; the forced reset runs only when something is stale, because _stop() runs every tick of a hold and Godot warns frequent forcing can stick agents. Alternative: force every call; no measured benefit.

The safety net keeps the sideways part of an answer that is against the wish instead of the briefed zero: zero froze a squeezed Punk at the player's nose for 1.5 s (observed seed 2) while two overlapping bodies' ORCA answers of 5-6 m/s pointed away from each other; the sideways part slides it out. Measured over four net variants (none, clamp only, zero, sideways): sideways has 0 capsule overlap frames, wrong-way <= 9 sub-90-degree frames, longest observed back-off 1.2/2.6/1.2/1.1 s against 1.2/2.6/2.3/1.1 s for zero; the clamp to the wish's length is what removes the 4-6 m/s dashes, the direction rule is what removes the wrong-way runs (clamp only still gives up to 86 wrong-way frames and a 6.1 s back-off).

The regression test uses a Punk walking into a crowd (navmesh, player obstacle, three token holders waiting at strike range via a stub director that gives the go to one enemy only), not a lone Punk: a lone Punk's back-off passes without the fix because the avoidance outputs its wish when there is no neighbour. The geometry fails unfixed at 6.00 m/s and passes at 2.60.

punk_attack_cooldown_s locked at 5.0 rather than 4.0 or 6.0 (lowest swept value with R8 p95 passing in every seed of observed, passive and Waves for seeds 0-3, R13 at 3 waves, a little more pressure than 6.0); 4.0 and 6.0 numbers are in the calls file for the lead.

test_slice_crowd: lengthened the rules run to 1350 frames (the observed act's length) instead of lowering the 'crowd attacks together' floor to 1, because the first overlap of two Punks at seed 0 falls at act frame 911, 11 frames after the old 900-frame window, and the act still shows the behaviour for 50-134 of 1344 frames.

Step 3 skipped by the brief's own condition (R8 p95 passes in 29 of 32 observed/passive/Waves/fight-p95 runs after steps 1 and 2; misses are marginal, 51-57%): not building the director go-time query or the back-step; the reviewer's prototype and the measured remaining cause are reported for the lead instead. Alternative: build the query for margin; rejected as a new tunable, a new director query and a changed ENGAGE for a soft metric that passes.
Did not touch tuning/default.json (regenerated locally for the suite, then checked out); did not write the gate file, HANDOFF, README or SPEC.
remaining: tuning/default.json must be regenerated by the lead (godot --headless -s tools/gen_default_preset.gd): punk_attack_cooldown_s is 5.0 in code but 1.4 in the committed preset, so test_tuning_panel fails until it is.

Waves and fight pressure fell about 70% and 60% at the 5 s cooldown (Waves hits in 90 s 32.8 -> 9.5, 3 waves cleared still); the lead decides attacker density (wave_max_alive, spawn table) and records the cadence default and the posture share (about a third of six, SPEC 7 says most) in M3-slice-gate.md. The cap of 3 never binds (max concurrent attackers 2).

Token holders still wait at the player's nose for the director's go: 4.5-9.3 s of a 22 s observed act, 34-53% of it while the player is in HITSTUN/STAGGER; one Punk covers 40-60% of the lens for 2-3 s while rear hits land (about a third of the remaining over-half lens samples). The director go-time query (time until may_start_windup() could pass; holder waits at a standoff and steps in when go <= distance / engage_speed_mps; engage_timeout_s and director_token_timeout_s must not expire a legitimate wait) is the fix if the gate wants it; not built.

The fight and Waves APPROACH share of lens coverage and the fight act's R8 p50 (24-32%, limit 25%) are the autopilot's own just-punched target at about 0.85 m: for the lead to argue in the gate file, untouched.
Long back-offs (1-2.6 s, sweeps of 100-113 degrees) still happen when another Punk blocks the way out: P1-int call 17's open slot or back-off decision, not attempted.

R12's worst 2 s of damage is exactly the limit of 30 in every passive run (the opening volley of fresh Punks has no cooldown); the cooldown only improved the KO time (12.2 s -> 14.3 s minimum). R9 blind-grant coverage in the crowd acts is mostly 'no mixed grants' at the new cadence (observed 0, passive 2 on average).

Side finding: a lone Punk exactly on the player's axis slows to 0.4 m/s at about 1.05 m (ORCA against the player's 0.3 m obstacle) and times out of ENGAGE; 0.1 m off the axis attacks normally. Needs a decision on the obstacle radius or the approach target.
The other archetypes' cooldowns (Kicker 1.2, Thug 1.8, Bruiser 2.2, Boss 1.8) never bind either; phase 2 needs its own values.
